claim_ceiling: Conceptual subsystem architecture tree for design review. Not a parts list, CAD, circuit/harness definition, supplier bill of materials, safety case or production/build authorization.
voltage_policy: No vehicle system voltage or connector compatibility is selected by this architecture catalogue; those decisions require mission-based current, thermal, protection, standards and service analysis.

architecture_patterns.label: Light electric assist
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Low-energy pack -> protected assist controller -> motor/reduction -> chain or final drive; independent mechanical braking.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: Voltage class is not selected in v0.1; choose only after current, thermal, regional rules, and service constraints are specified.
primary_gates: human override and safe fault state

architecture_patterns.label: Road passenger battery electric
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Pack -> fuse/contactors/pre-charge/isolation monitoring -> traction DC link -> inverter -> e-drive/reduction/axle; DC/DC serves low-voltage consumers; onboard AC charging and any DC fast-charge path are explicit interfaces.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: Vehicle voltage class is unselected; rate current paths, insulation, contactors, connectors, protection and thermal design from the actual power envelope.
primary_gates: charge inlet interoperability and thermal limit
HV safe service and fault isolation

architecture_patterns.label: Accessible transit electric
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Protected pack -> HV distribution -> rear e-axle or approved drive axle; independently metered HVAC, doors, ramp/lift and low-voltage/accessibility branches.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: Voltage classes and interfaces are not asserted. Access systems require safe degraded behavior under vehicle and auxiliary faults.

architecture_patterns.label: Electric work vehicle
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Protected pack and HV distribution branch to traction and a separately metered work-tool bus (electric pump, PTO substitute, hoist, refrigeration or implement power as fitted).
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: Each traction/work branch must be rated to simultaneous loads; connector, hydraulic and isolation requirements remain machine-specific.
primary_gates: continuous low-speed torque and thermal duty

architecture_patterns.label: Road EV with qualified stationary power export
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Road traction path plus a separate bidirectional converter and isolated output path with protection, grounding/bonding and mode interlocks.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: No grid-forming, building connection, island operation or backfeed is enabled by architecture alone; only qualified export modes may be implemented.

architecture_patterns.label: Heavy road / terminal battery electric
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Protected high-energy pack(s) -> protected DC link -> one or more high-torque e-drives/drive axles; friction braking and qualified retarding remain independent; charging/site power is co-designed.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: No pack voltage, axle or MCS acceptance is assumed. Current path, connector, cooling, rest-window and site acceptance must be verified together.
primary_gates: grade endurance and brake thermal limits

architecture_patterns.label: Trolley plus off-wire battery
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Qualified trolley collector and protective interface feeds the traction DC bus on covered corridors; a controlled bidirectional DC/DC or equivalent safe interface manages off-wire battery reserve.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: Trolley voltage/current, collection equipment and battery interface are site/system-specific; isolation and transition behavior require qualification.
primary_gates: loss of trolley and safe transition

architecture_patterns.label: Tracked electric work machine
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Protected pack -> traction inverter(s) -> track drive; separately metered electric motor/pump feeds hydraulic work circuit, with mechanical and electrical safe-service states coordinated.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: Drive, pump, hydraulic and pack thermal limits are independently defined; no universal pump or battery module is assumed.

architecture_patterns.label: Autonomous yard/material carrier
architecture_patterns.energy_path: Protected pack -> drive/stopping actuators and supervisory controller; controlled automatic docking/charge interface, safety controller and independent emergency-stop path.
architecture_patterns.voltage_decision: Drive/sensor/safety-controller supply and charging interface are not specified as interchangeable. Brownout and communications-loss states require tests.
